violation_type.title: Temporary Relocation -Allow Licensing to inspect (26 TAC §745.5101(2)(C))
violation_type.typical_finding: This standard was reviewed in relation to the reported allegations and found to be deficient. The operation started operating in a temporary location on 7/14/25 without prior approval from Child Care Regulation.
